Hey Guys,

I posted this over in /v/gunporn but I figured I'd do a quick write-up over here as well since I can't sleep. I just picked this shotgun up yesterday for the sole purpose of shooting skeet. I was debating it for a long time, but I figured hey, why not? It's my first double barrel that I've ever owned, although I have used others. I've used semi's for skeet mostly up until now. Going from a semi to a double barrel is a huge change. While that's probably obvious to most of y'all, it was a shocker just how different it is to me. The ease of tracking the clays is immense, and I definitely noticed my arm growing less sore as a result. I do miss the light recoil of my Mossberg 930 due to the energy bleed of the action cycling. The recoil because of the porting on the SC1 seems easily controllable.

I have also noticed that there is little to no muzzle rise as far as I can perceive. There is one huge drawback on the SC1 as I can tell, and that is the barrel selector. Having to use the safety selector and moving it in a U pattern to select barrels I can see leading to some crappy safety practices and it is pretty clunky to switch. I suspect just like with the break this will wear in over time and become smoother, but for now it is awkward and something that stays in the corner of my mind. Otherwise, it was an absolute blast to shoot today. Only got to break 100 clays before bad weather forced me off the range. I will be heading back out later this week and hopefully can post a more detailed range report once I've really gotten to know it and it's capabilities.
